title: Chaos Cubed Expanded
description: (New 1.1.0 update!) This mod add a lot of new content to the Chaos Cubed update!
body:
### ![Chaos Cubed Expanded](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37aef726233c24dc300f06f48b411862e8b2cbec.png)
### 
### What's this mod?
### 
This mod add new content to the **Chaos Cubed Update** It features new itmes, new crafting recepis, new loot in Sulfur caves, and new trade from the wandering trader.

![OverView of Evrything!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5601f6dab61078c3cb19dce1882cb21482410f0e.webp)

### 
### What does this mod add?
### 
1.The Sulfur ore and crystal: This is a new ore you can find in caves or in the sulfur caves, and it also has a deepslate variant. Smelting it gives you the new crystal, the Sulfur Crystal, which can craft the new sulfur tools and armor — sword, axe, pickaxe, shovel, hoe, spear, helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots.
2.Sulfur and Cinnabar ores: These are new variations of the normal ores (coal, iron, copper, gold, redstone, lapis, diamond, emerald, and sulfur itself) you can find them in the sulfur caves instead of the normal stone and deepslate ones. The Cinnabar ores are the red-colored versions and are a bit harder to mine.
3.Sulfur Spider: This is a new mob, it's like a normal spider but it spawns in the sulfur caves (and also in lush caves, dripstone caves, and the deep dark). It's rarer than a normal spider but you can find it. There's also a Sulfur Spider Spawn Egg, and rarely (1-in-5 chance) sulfur spiders can appear in monster rooms instead of regular spiders.
4.A new painting: This new painting is called "Sulfur Horizon". It is a 2 by 2 painting based on the panorama of the 26.2 title screen, and it's been added to the placeable painting pool so you can roll it from vanilla paintings.

5.Sulfur Goo: This item comes from the Sulfur Cube. You can get it by killing a baby Sulfur Cube. You can use it to craft Sulfur blocks, and with Redstone you can craft Cinnabar.
6.Wandering Traders: Wandering traders have a chance to sell you Sulfur Goo.
7.Dyeable Sulfur Cubes: You can use all dyes to dye the Sulfur Cube to any color, including the babies. The buckets get the dyeable treatment too — when you get the Sulfur Cube in a bucket, you get the color of the Sulfur Cube you dyed.
8.Sulfur Slime Block: This block can be crafted with 9 Sulfur Goo. This Sulfur Slime can be used to grow the normal and baby Sulfur Cubes.
9.Baby Sulfur Cube Block: A decorative smaller version of the Sulfur block. You can place it as a block, and it drops itself when broken with shears. Otherwise it drops Sulfur Goo.
10.Block Absorption: Baby Sulfur Cubes can absorb the same vanilla-allowed blocks as normal Sulfur Cubes — planks, dirt, stone, copper, ice, wool, etc. Right-click a baby with a block to put it inside, right-click with shears to remove it. Uses the vanilla Sulfur Cube absorb and eject sounds.
11.Growth Mechanic: Feed Sulfur Slime Blocks to any Sulfur Cube baby or adult to make it grow. Right-click the cube with a Sulfur Slime Block, or drop it on the ground near the cube and it will eat it automatically. Bigger cubes have bigger explosions.
12.Explosion Scaling: Sulfur Cube explosions now scale with size. Baby cubes (size 1) make small explosions, while larger cubes make bigger ones. A baby with TNT makes a small TNT-style explosion; a full-grown cube with TNT makes a big one.
13.Mineshaft Loot: Sulfur Goo can be found in abandoned mineshaft chests, including those in the Sulfur Caves biome.
14.Full Localization: All items and blocks are translated into every language Minecraft supports, including meme languages like LOLCAT, upside-down English, Classical Chinese, Klingon, Latin, and more.
15.Creative Tab Placement: Sulfur Goo appears in the Ingredients tab next to the Slime Ball. The Baby Sulfur Cube appears in the Building Blocks tab next to the Sulfur block. The Sulfur Slime Block appears in the Redstone tab next to the Slime Block. The new Sulfur tools appear in the Tools tab next to their iron counterparts, and the Sulfur weapons and armor appear in the Combat tab next to the iron gear. The Sulfur Spider Spawn Egg appears in the Spawn Eggs tab next to the vanilla Spider Spawn Egg.
